GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landing in front didn't stay there balancing up Two Wide fourth 4 Lengths (1400m), 3 Lengths 600 Ridden Along looking to improve, cornered to the Outside all Clear if good enough, did run on however not well enough # sound/gave all

Jumped okay, slow into stride (-1 length) and Settled Down 7 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 6.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, around heels and into clear running Straightening Up , ran out 4-5 Wide in Straight hitting Lead at the 50m # ran on well/solid
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Shifted out rounding the home turn brushing EXPRESS STAR.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled back 3rd last rails 11 Lengths 1000m, still well back getting off fence at 250m, Made Some Ground but was never close # Never Likely

Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide middle stages, worked forward from the 500m, trailed 4 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Five Wide Straightening Up and ran on hitting Lead in the final strides # wide, ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , got back long 2nd last 11 Lengths 800m, still well off them between runners on the corner, knuckled down last 200m weaving a passage to grab eye catching minor placing # eye catching place
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced keenly 5th on inside (4L from lead). Held Ground until pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 450m & pushed along Four Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 200m & ran on OK in last 150m. # Best work last 150m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 350m, laid in and became awkward on heels. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1.5 Lengths & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, hugged rail rounding turn and then Made Ground along fence in Straight # slow start no help

Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, made no ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted 3 Wide and Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Rider reported it may not be suited to the tight turning track. Post-race vet exam revealed lacerations indicating speedy cuts to both fore legs.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported gelding may not be suited to the tight turning track. A post-race vet exam revealed lacerations indicating speedy cuts to both fore legs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, taken straight across & Settled Down 6 Lengths Two Wide , out 3 Wide from 700m, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Hooked Out to centre of track Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # back/ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in, bumped, and became unbalanced. Raced wide from the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Not pushed early & raced 4th Two Wide (3L from lead). Improved to tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 450m. Out Four Wide @ 400m & pressured Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Hit lead @ 150m & grabbed in last 50m. # Every Chance
Jumped okay & Settled Down 4 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, shifted Wide rounding turn, Made Some Ground down centre of track in Straight # wide, ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Raced wide for the majority. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.
